title: Users
description: People who can sign in to Canopy, and the roles they hold.
search: Search by name, username or email

form.createDescription: They can sign in right away with this password and change it from their account page.
form.rolesHint: Roles add up. Groups can grant more.

errors.username: Use 3–32 characters: letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
errors.displayName: Enter a name of 64 characters or fewer.
errors.contactEmail: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.

resetPassword.title: Reset the password of {name}
resetPassword.description: They will be signed out everywhere and must use the new password.

confirm.disableDescription: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until enabled again.
confirm.deleteDescription: The account, its sessions and its two-factor setup are removed for good. Audit entries are kept.
confirm.resetTwoFactorDescription: Their authenticator and recovery codes are removed and they are signed out. They can set it up again after signing in.
confirm.revokeSessionsDescription: Every session of this account ends now.
